title: Why Adaptive Optimizers Struggle with Large Convolution Kernels
abstract: arXiv:2611.29232v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large convolution kernels enlarge the receptive fields of ConvNets at a modest computational cost, but they are notoriously difficult to train. Existing large-kernel networks therefore rely on costly training techniques, such as parallel small-kernel branches with batch normalization. In this paper, we trace this difficulty to adaptive optimizers such as Adam, which normalize the update of every weight separately. Since input features rarely average to zero, all weights of a kernel share a common gradient, and these optimizers move the mean of a $k\times k$ kernel $k$ times as far as a single parameter. We find this mean amplification in widely used ConvNets and vision transformers, and show that it can force the maximal learning rate to fall as $1/k^2$. We further prove that the basis of the discrete cosine transform (DCT) isolates the mean and is the only orthonormal basis that diagonalizes every stationary gradient statistic with mi

translated_title: 为什么自适应优化器难以训练大卷积核
translated_abstract: 大卷积核能够以较低的计算成本扩大卷积网络的感受野，但其训练却出了名地困难。因此，现有的大核网络不得不依赖代价高昂的训练技术，例如带有批归一化的并行小核分支。在本文中，我们将这一训练困难追溯到Adam等自适应优化器，这类优化器会对每个权重的更新单独进行归一化。由于输入特征的均值很少为零，卷积核的所有权重会共享一个共同的梯度分量，这使得这些优化器对k×k卷积核均值的移动距离达到单个参数的k倍。我们在广泛使用的卷积网络和视觉Transformer中都发现了这种均值放大现象，并证明它会迫使最大学习率按1/k²的规律下降。我们进一步证明，离散余弦变换（DCT）的基能够隔离均值分量，并且是唯一能以最小代价对角化所有平稳梯度统计量的标准正交基……
tldr: 论文揭示了Adam等自适应优化器的逐权重归一化机制会放大卷积核均值的更新幅度k倍，导致大卷积核训练困难（最大学习率需按1/k²下降），并从理论上证明DCT基是唯一能隔离均值并最优对角化梯度统计量的正交基。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that adaptive optimizers like Adam amplify the mean update of convolution kernels k-fold due to per-weight normalization, forcing the maximal learning rate to fall as 1/k² for large kernels, and proves that the DCT basis is the unique orthonormal basis that isolates the mean and optimally diagonalizes stationary gradient statistics.
